integrity: The claim is proved symbolically from the published +2 ideal-edge bookkeeping for nontrivial decomposition crushes and the prime-preserving crush mechanism for overlength prime loops. No computational experiment or unverified census assertion is used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The refinement is sequence-sensitive: it yields a stronger lower bound only when the prime-output excess is known to occupy more than one component, or when its concentration can be bounded. It does not settle tightness of the published composite-knot complexity bound.
title: Excess-dispersion refinement for edge-ideal knot crushing
